skip_policy: Existing opt-in live AI/network suites, S3 live tests and container-smoke tests remain disabled by upstream test guards; no test or guard was removed or weakened. Local deployment smoke is a separate experiment, not an assertion that every optional integration was tested.

conditional_skip_difference.condition: The test calls ctx.skip() when its fixture project is not first by name, then id, within the workspace. Generated fixture names/ids can change this branch.
conditional_skip_difference.evidence: This is the sole runtime ctx.skip() found among test sources; the other guards are fixed opt-in environment guards. Consistent with the observed one-test difference; individual passed-test names were not captured by the default reporter.
conditional_skip_difference.limitation: Full-gate observations are not an exact matched test-outcome sample and are not sufficient for a causal speedup claim.
